title: review follow-ups of PR #34517
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQ2SN4K183oqAvUajA

Filing gate: L1/L2 follow-ups, one card per PR (the `review follow-ups of PR #N` exception). Source: L2 contract-review record 6933706748 on PR #34517 (card #34373), items N2 and N3. Dedupe: `review follow-ups of PR #34517`, `lockRows dialect`.

Suggested-grade: p2 · `domain:server` · `pm:blocked`, Blocked-by #34373 (the bit lands first)

## 维护者速读

- 现象:#34373 给驱动加了 `lockRows` 能力位。TSDoc 把 MySQL 和 SQL Server 上的行为写成了事实，驱动在所有方言(含 Oracle)都声明了这个位，但实测过的只有 PostgreSQL 和 SQLite。Turso 远端模式没有事务，却继承了 `lockRows: true`。
- 为什么要修：声明了没实测的能力，AI 和调用方会照着用;Oracle 上带行数限制的加锁读很可能被数据库拒绝。经引擎走不会出错，直接调用才会碰到。
- 需要你做的：无。

## Items

- [ ] N2: measure the `lockRows` read on MySQL, SQL Server and Oracle (the `findOne()` case on Oracle included). Name the measured dialects in the bit's TSDoc, as the `aggregationFilter` precedent does. A dialect that refuses turns the bit off for that dialect, with a pin.
- [ ] N3 (lands in the Turso driver's own repository, not this one): the remote transport declares `lockRows: false`, by the precedent the `SqlDriver.supports` literal sets for `transactionsUnsupported` and `aggregationFilter`. The seat that holds that repository carries it; this item is ticked when its PR merges.

## Done when

Each dialect cell is measured or the bit is off for it, and the TSDoc names only measured dialects.

Blocked-by: #34373
